<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/developer/workspaces/{workspace_id}/features"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Switch Balances and/or Accounting on or off for one of your white-label workspaces; send at least one. Switching on computes over the whole history (poll the returned task), then keeps it up to date after every sync. Switching off stops computing, and the feature's endpoints return 403 FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED from the next request. Each feature must be granted to your client; accounting needs balances.
